package com.acme.service;

import com.acme.model.*;
import com.acme.model.Point;
import com.acme.model.Shape;

@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@interface Tracked {
    String value() default "";
    int priority() default 1;
}

public class Registry implements OwnerService, Cache<String, Shape<?>> {
    private final Map<String, Shape<?>> shapes = new java.util.HashMap<>();
    private final ShapeRepository repo;
    private final ShapeValidator validator;
    private Owner owner;

    @Tracked(value = "ctor", priority = 2)
    public Registry(ShapeRepository repo, ShapeValidator validator) {
        this.repo = repo;
        this.validator = validator;
    }

    public static Shape<?> lookup(String key) {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public Owner find(int id) {
        Shape<?> s = repo.load(id);
        validator.check(s);
        owner.rename("x");
        Point p = Point.origin();
        p.move(1);
        area();
        name();
        compareTo(null);
        return repo.owner(id).orElseThrow();
    }

    public List<Point> points(Set<Owner> owners, Owner[] arr, java.util.List<Point> qualified) {
        return null;
    }
}
